description: Defines a template class 'RecorderType' for recording and managing time-stamped measurement data with delta compression, including nested classes for writing and reading recordings, and handling file storage.

classes.name: RecorderType
classes.description: Template class for recording measurement data with delta encoding, supporting file storage, snapshot, and navigation through recorded data.

classes.name: BaseRecorder
classes.description: Internal base class managing buffer, start/end data, and delta encoding logic.

classes.name: RecorderType::Writer
classes.description: Handles writing measurement data to files, managing file IDs, and buffering.

classes.name: RecorderType::Reader
classes.description: Handles reading measurement data from files, supporting navigation and data validation.

methods.name: Store
methods.description: Stores a measurement with timestamp and value, updating internal delta encoding.

methods.name: StepForward
methods.description: Advances to the next measurement, decoding delta-encoded data.

methods.name: StepBack
methods.description: Moves to the previous measurement, decoding delta-encoded data.

methods.name: SnapShot
methods.description: Creates a snapshot of current data state into another recorder.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads data from a file into the recorder, reconstructing measurement sequence.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Saves current data to a file.

methods.name: ClearData
methods.description: Resets internal data to initial state.
